# Set-Up
```{r packages}
# Packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
```

```{r Path}
# Path
p <- "../data/processed/changchangpan/capstone_llm_data_explore_r_outputs"
```


# Vignette Characteristics

## Continuous Variables
```{r continuous-vignettes}
read_csv(file.path(p, "vignette_numeric_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 1))) %>%
  rename(Variable = variable, N = n, Mean = mean, SD = sd,
         Median = median, Q1 = q1, Q3 = q3, Min = min, Max = max) %>%
  kable(caption = "Continuous Characteristics (n = 100 vignettes)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Binary Characteristics
```{r binary-vignettes}
read_csv(file.path(p, "vignette_binary_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(value == "Yes") %>%
  select(Variable = variable, `n (Yes)` = n, `% (Yes)` = pct) %>%
  kable(caption = "Binary Characteristics — % present (n = 100 vignettes)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


# Clinical Subgroup Distributions
```{r subgroup-dist}
read_csv(file.path(p, "clinical_subgroup_counts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Group = group, Category = category, N = n, `%` = pct) %>%
  kable(caption = "Clinical Subgroup Distributions (n = 100 vignettes)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")
```


# Missingness
```{r missingness}
read_csv(file.path(p, "missingness_key_variables.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)%>%
  rename(Variable = variable, `Missing (n)` = missing_n, `Missing (%)` =
           missing_pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Missing (%)`)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Missingness in Key Variables (300 rows)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

**Note:** `current_dm_drugs` is missing in 49% of rows because newly diagnosed
patients had no prior diabetes medications.


# Data Quality
```{r data-quality}
read_csv(file.path(p, "data_quality_basic_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)%>%
  kable(caption = "Data Quality Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```


# Recommendation Rates by Model
```{r recc-rates-model}
read_csv(file.path(p, "recommendation_rates_by_model.csv"), show_col_types =
           FALSE) %>%
  rename(Model = model_short) %>%
  kable(caption = "Recommendation Rates (%) by Model (n = 100 per model)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Heatmap
```{r, fig.align = "center"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(p, "medication_rates_by_model_heatmap.png"))
```


# Range Across Models
```{r feature-ranges}
read_csv(file.path(p, "model_to_model_feature_ranges.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(range_pct_points)) %>%
  rename(Feature = feature, `Min %` = min_pct, `Max %` = max_pct,
         `Range (pp)` = range_pct_points) %>%
  kable(caption = "Range in Recommendation Rates Across Models (percentage points)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```


# Model Agreement
```{r model-agreement}
read_csv(file.path(p, "model_agreement_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(pct_agree) %>%
  rename(Feature = feature, `N vignettes` = n_cases,
         `All agree` = n_agree, `Any disagreement` = n_disagree,
         `% agreement` = pct_agree) %>%
  kable(caption = "Model Agreement Across all 3 Models (97 evaluable vignettes)")%>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


# High-Disagreement Cases
```{r high-disagreement}
read_csv(file.path(p, "high_disagreement_cases.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(disagreement_score >= 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(disagreement_score)) %>%
  rename(`Case ID` = case_id, `# drugs disagreed` = disagreement_score,
         `Disagreed features` = disagreed_features) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cases with Disagreement on 3+ Drug Classes") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


```{r guideline-flags}
read_csv(file.path(p, "exploratory_guideline_flags.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)%>%
  rename(Condition = condition, Feature = feature, Model = model_short,
         N = n, `%` = pct) %>%
  kable(caption = "Guideline Adherence Flags by Condition and Model") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "top")
```
